acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.body: By accessing or using TelegramPlugin ("the Service"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, do not use the Service.

description.title: 2. Description of Service
description.body: TelegramPlugin provides a platform for creators to monetize their communities on Telegram, Discord, and WhatsApp through subscriptions and one-time payments. We facilitate:

list.item2: Automatic access management to your channels

account.title: 3. Account Registration
account.body: To use the Service, you must:

list.item2: Provide accurate and complete registration information
list.item3: Maintain the security of your account credentials
list.item4: Accept responsibility for all activities under your account

subscription.title: 4.1 Subscription Fee
subscription.body: The Service is offered at a flat monthly fee of €39. We charge 0% commission on your sales. Standard Stripe processing fees apply separately.

trial.title: 4.2 Free Trial
trial.body: New accounts receive a 14-day free trial. No credit card is required to start. At the end of the trial, you must subscribe to continue using the Service.

billing.title: 4.3 Billing
billing.body: Subscription fees are billed monthly in advance. You may cancel at any time; service continues until the end of the billing period.

acceptableUse.title: 5. Acceptable Use
acceptableUse.body: You agree not to use the Service to:

list.item1: Violate any applicable laws or regulations
list.item5: Engage in fraud or deceptive practices
list.item7: Circumvent platform restrictions on Telegram, Discord, or WhatsApp

responsibilities.title: 6. Your Responsibilities
responsibilities.body: As a creator using our platform, you are responsible for:

list.item1: Complying with tax obligations in your jurisdiction
list.item2: Providing accurate descriptions of your products
list.item3: Delivering the access and content promised to your customers
list.item4: Handling customer support for your products
list.item5: Complying with the terms of service of connected platforms

intellectualProperty.title: 7. Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.body: You retain ownership of your content. By using the Service, you grant us a limited license to display and process your content as necessary to provide the Service.

liability.title: 8. Limitation of Liability
liability.body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, TelegramPlugin shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, including loss of profits, data, or business opportunities.

availability.title: 9. Service Availability
availability.body: We strive for high availability but do not guarantee uninterrupted service. We may perform maintenance or updates that temporarily affect availability.

termination.title: 10. Termination
termination.body: We may suspend or terminate your account for violation of these terms or for any other reason at our discretion. You may cancel your account at any time through your dashboard.

changes.title: 11. Changes to Terms
changes.body: We may modify these terms at any time. We will notify you of material changes via email. Continued use of the Service after changes constitutes acceptance.

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.body1: TelegramPlugin ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our platform.
introduction.body2: We are based in the European Union and comply with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and other applicable data protection laws.

commitment.body: TelegramPlugin is fully committed to GDPR compliance. As an EU-based company, we have built our platform with privacy by design and data protection as core principles.

hero.title: Simple, transparent pricing
hero.subtitle: One plan. No hidden fees. No commission on your sales.

example.label: Example:
example.text: If you make €5,000/month, competitors charge €150-750 in commission.
example.highlight: With us, you pay €39. You save €111-711 every month.

item1.question: Is there really 0% commission?
item1.answer: Yes. We charge a flat monthly fee only. You keep 100% of your revenue. Stripe processing fees (typically 1.4% + €0.25 for EU cards) are separate and go directly to Stripe, not us.

item2.question: What happens after the free trial?
item2.answer: Your account continues to work. We'll send you a reminder before the trial ends. If you don't upgrade, your payment links will pause until you subscribe.

item3.question: Can I cancel anytime?
item3.answer: Absolutely. No contracts, no commitments. Cancel from your dashboard with one click. Your existing members keep their access until their subscriptions expire.

item4.question: Do I need a Stripe account?
item4.answer: Yes. We use Stripe Connect so payments go directly to your Stripe account. If you don't have one, you can create it during onboarding - it takes about 5 minutes.

item5.question: Which platforms are supported?
item5.answer: Currently Telegram (including Telegram Stars), with Discord and WhatsApp coming soon. You can manage all platforms from a single dashboard.

item6.question: Is my data safe?
item6.answer: We're EU-based and fully GDPR-compliant. Your data is stored in European data centers. You can export or delete your data anytime from your dashboard.

hero.title: Empowering European creators to monetize their communities
hero.body: TelegramPlugin was born from a simple observation: creators in Europe deserve better tools. While US-based platforms dominate the market, European creators face unique challenges — from payment processing restrictions to GDPR compliance.

paragraphs.p1: We started as creators ourselves, running Telegram communities and struggling with the same problems you face: clunky payment solutions, high commissions eating into our revenue, and tools that weren't designed with European regulations in mind.
paragraphs.p2: In 2025, we decided to build the platform we wished existed. One that puts creators first, respects privacy, and doesn't take a cut of your hard-earned revenue.
paragraphs.p3: Today, TelegramPlugin helps hundreds of creators across Europe monetize their Telegram, Discord, and WhatsApp communities — without the headaches.
